reviewer_role: proposal author; independent of the packet builder, not an independent experimental confirmer
scope: Target-arm semantic parity and target answer-key correctness under the supplied definitions. All 752 targets reviewed; canonical file digests include 12 calibration rows per packet, but acceptance does not cover calibration or execution machinery.
limits: Not an experimental replication, ratification vote, reader qualification or automatic clearance of live cost/eligibility gates.
Every primary guarantee answer and every certification answer is no; supplied cautions limit findings to caveated examples, not general guarantee/model-truth discrimination.
Constant-answer baselines: primary joint vector 50%, supplementary joint vector 80%, specification rejection 75%.
Shared worlds and repeated templates are not independent scenarios.
